description: This file defines the Sale class, which extends a basic object class and encapsulates functionality related to sales, including creating list queries, filling in list and detail fields, and saving sale data with currency conversions. It is part of the SuiteCRM project and includes licensing and project-specific comments.

classes.name: Sale
classes.description: A class representing a sale object that manages sale-related data, including currency conversion, list query creation, and data persistence.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Creates a new list query for Sale objects, ensuring 'amount_usdollar' is included in the filters.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Fills in additional list fields, particularly ensuring 'amount_usdollar' is populated correctly.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Fills in additional detail fields, ensuring 'amount_usdollar' is populated.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the sale object, converting the amount to USDollar based on the currency, and then persists the object.
